title: Ops digest: trace controls, dashboard drafts & cost telemetry notes (2026-03-09 to 2026-03-13)
body:
Summary
- This week focused on three threads: (1) making tracing sampling adaptive for low-traffic services, (2) shipping a first-pass cost telemetry dashboard for inference routes, and (3) prototyping a per-route cost tagging flow to connect billing to dashboards.
- Goal for next week: cut observable unit cost of hosted API by 8% via batching & sampling changes, and finalize dashboard filters for product.

Standup / daily notes (concise)
- Mon 2026-03-09: Reviewed production trace volume spike (02:10-02:35 UTC) — root cause: runaway retry loop in internal-router v2 (service id: ir-v2). Created OBS-4023. Tracing retention temporarily increased to 48h for ir-v2 to help triage (Priya).
- Tue 2026-03-10: Drafted adaptive sampling proposal (see link OBS-4021). Prototype sampler implemented in staging: samples = base 0.5% + 1.0% for error traces + per-service multiplier for services with >5k TPS. Initial tests reduce traces by ~22% without losing failures.
- Wed 2026-03-11: Dashboard working session — instrumented per-route labels from API gateway (route_name, model_variant, customer_tier) into Prometheus exporters. Luis completed exporter patch (PR #287). Observability infra accepted patch; rolling to staging.
- Thu 2026-03-12: Cost telemetry spike investigation — hosted-inference GPU hour cost attribution missing for some VPC accounts due to tag mismatch. Found split between infra tags (env:prod) and billing tags (environment:production). Flagged to infra team, created follow-up OBS-4033.
- Fri 2026-03-13: Feature freeze for dashboard MVP. Conducted readout with Console product (Sofia) and Solutions eng; agreed on filters and CSV export format. Action items assigned below.

Decisions and rationale
- Adaptive sampling: enable default adaptive sampler in staging for 7 days, then roll to production with a feature flag. Rationale: significant trace cost reduction while keeping error-focused sampling.
- Per-route cost tagging: require gateway to emit model_variant and route_name tags in telemetry. Rationale: without these, per-feature cost allocation is noisy and we can't produce customer-facing breakdowns.
- Dashboard retention: keep 30d of high-cardinality traces in long-term store for canary customers only (privacy/size tradeoff).

Metrics snapshot (end-of-week)
- Total traces/day (prod): 14.1M (down from 18.2M before sampling tests)
- Error traces/day: 22.5k
- Traces captured for internal-router (ir-v2) during spike: 48k
- Prometheus scrape rate (avg): 9.8k samples/s
- Estimated observability infra cost (monthly projection): $24.3k (after projected sampling changes: $18.4k)
- Hosted API inference attributed telemetry (sample): 3.7% of infra cost per 1M tokens for small models (pre-optimization)

Draft dashboard notes (MVP)
- Top row: global KPIs — traces/day, errors/day, avg trace duration, p95 error duration, observability spend (daily)
- Middle: per-route cost breakout — bar chart showing cost by route_name with model_variant filter; table with tokens, requests, cost, avg latency
- Bottom: alerts & incidents — last 14 days list tied to traces & traces links to spans
- CSV export: route_name, model_variant, customer_tier, tokens, requests, cost_usd, date

Prometheus / Loki query snippets (for dashboard cells)
- Cost per route (pseudo-promql): sum by (route_name) (increase(inference_cost_usd_total{job=\"billing-export\"}[30d]))
- Error traces count (label-based): sum by (route_name) (increase(traces_total{result=\"error\"}[1d]))
- Average trace duration p95 (pseudo): histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(trace_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route_name))

Implementation notes / patches
- PR #287 (observability exporter): adds route_name + model_variant labels to gateway metrics. Staging rollout scheduled Mon 03-16. Reviewer: Ethan.
- Adaptive sampler config: YAML draft included in OBS-4021. Key knobs: base_sample_rate, error_boost, per_service_multiplier_map, preserve_top_n_traces.
- Billing join: proposed lightweight ETL that maps infra tags -> dashboard tags nightly. Prototype SQL in Confluence doc.

Open issues / risks
- High-cardinality from model_variant + customer_tier labels could blow up Prometheus cardinality. Mitigation: cardinality cap + aggregation in long-term store (Thanos). Need infra sign-off.
- Some VPC/on-prem deployments cannot emit route_name due to older gateway versions — will need a backfill plan or fallback heuristics.
- Cost attribution accuracy depends on consistent tag hygiene across infra teams — multi-team coordination required.

Action items (owners & deadlines)
- Maya: Roll adaptive sampler to staging and run 7-day experiment (start 2026-03-16). Deadline: 2026-03-23.
- Ethan: Complete review and merge PR #287; coordinate staging checks. Deadline: 2026-03-16.
- Priya: Work with infra to normalize billing tags for VPC customers; produce mapping table. Deadline: 2026-03-18.
- Luis: Implement cardinality cap in Prometheus relabel rules and test in staging. Deadline: 2026-03-19.
- Sofia: Finalize dashboard acceptance criteria with Console PM and send spec to UX. Deadline: 2026-03-17.

Notes to self / loose ideas
- Consider adding a "cost per 1M tokens" derived metric for product to easily understand unit economics.
- Try a hybrid sampling mode that preserves full traces for canary customers (tagged) while sampling others.
- Keep a rolling log of sampling config changes in git with clear PR descriptions for audits.

Appendix: quick logs / commands used this week
- Top traced services: internal-router, tokenizer, request-router
- Command to estimate cost: ./tools/estimate_costs --window 30d --filters route_name=api/complete
- Staging check: curl -H 'X-Route: api/complete' https://staging-gateway.redwood.internal/healthz

Next sync: Monday 2026-03-16 11:00 PT (obs-weekly). Please add any pre-reads to the Confluence page linked above before EOD Friday.

-- Maya
